# Terraform AWS Grafana Prometheus Module

 [![Latest Release](https://img.shields.io/github/release/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-aws-grafana-prometheus.svg?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-aws-grafana-prometheus/releases/latest) [![Last Updated](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-aws-grafana-prometheus.svg?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-aws-grafana-prometheus/commits)


Terraform module for provisioning a complete AWS observability stack using Amazon Managed Prometheus (AMP)
and Amazon Managed Grafana. Supports multi-workspace Prometheus deployments, automatic EKS metrics scraping,
CloudWatch log integration, KMS encryption at rest, VPC isolation for Grafana, and AWS SSO role-based
access control.


---

This project is part of our comprehensive approach towards DevOps Acceleration.

## Introduction

## Overview

This module deploys a production-ready observability infrastructure on AWS, combining:

- **Amazon Managed Prometheus (AMP)**: Fully managed, Prometheus-compatible monitoring service.
  The module supports multiple named workspaces, each with optional CloudWatch log forwarding
  and configurable metric scrapers targeting EKS clusters.

- **Amazon Managed Grafana**: Managed Grafana workspace for visualization and alerting,
  with pre-configured IAM permissions for Amazon Prometheus, CloudWatch, and X-Ray data sources.
  Supports AWS SSO integration for enterprise access control.

- **KMS Encryption**: Optional customer-managed KMS key for encrypting Prometheus workspaces
  and CloudWatch log groups, with least-privilege key policies scoped to the AMP service and
  CloudWatch Logs service endpoints.

- **VPC Integration**: Optional VPC configuration for Grafana to ensure network-level isolation,
  including automatic security group creation.

## Key Features

- Multiple Prometheus workspaces with independent scraper configurations
- Automatic EKS cluster discovery by name (or manual ARN-based configuration)
- Custom or default Prometheus scrape configurations per scraper
- AWS SSO group and user role assignments for Grafana (ADMIN, EDITOR, VIEWER)
- Consistent resource naming using organizational unit, environment, and spoke identifiers
- Standardized tagging via the CloudOpsWorks tags module

## Usage

Instead pin to the release tag (e.g. `?ref=vX.Y.Z`) of one of our [latest releases](https://github.com/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-aws-grafana-prometheus/releases).


## Full Configuration Example

The following Terragrunt HCL configuration demonstrates all available options for this module.

```hcl
terraform {
  source = "github.com/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-aws-grafana-prometheus.git//?ref=v1.0.0"
}

include "root" {
  path = find_in_parent_folders()
}

inputs = {
  is_hub    = false   # (Optional) Set true for hub configuration in hub/spoke topology. Default: false.
  spoke_def = "001"   # (Optional) Spoke identifier used in resource naming. Default: "001".

  org = {
    organization_name = "MyCompany"   # (Required) Full organization name.
    organization_unit = "platform"    # (Required) Organizational unit short name (used in resource names).
    environment_type  = "prod"        # (Required) Environment type (e.g., prod, staging, dev).
    environment_name  = "production"  # (Required) Environment name (e.g., production, staging).
  }

  extra_tags = {
    Project = "observability"         # (Optional) Additional tags to merge with auto-generated tags.
  }

  kms = {
    create                  = true   # (Optional) Create a KMS key for encryption at rest. Default: false.
    enable_key_rotation     = true   # (Optional) Enable automatic KMS key rotation. Default: false.
    rotation_period_in_days = 90     # (Optional) Key rotation period in days (90-2560). Default: 90.
  }

  prometheus = {
    main = {
      name_prefix = "platform"       # (Optional) Prefix for auto-generated workspace alias. Required if name not set.
      # name: "my-workspace"         # (Optional) Full workspace alias. Overrides name_prefix.
      logging = {
        create_log_group  = true     # (Optional) Create a CloudWatch Log Group for this workspace. Default: false.
        retention_in_days = 30       # (Optional) Log retention in days. Default: 7.
        log_group_class   = "STANDARD"  # (Optional) Log group class. Values: STANDARD, INFREQUENT_ACCESS. Default: "STANDARD".
        # log_group_arn: "arn:..."   # (Optional) Existing log group ARN. Used when create_log_group is false.
      }
      scrapers = {
        eks-main = {
          name_prefix = "platform"   # (Optional) Prefix for auto-generated scraper alias. Required if name not set.
          # name: "my-scraper"       # (Optional) Full scraper alias. Overrides name_prefix.
          # config: "..."            # (Optional) Custom Prometheus scrape config YAML. Uses AWS default if omitted.
        }
      }
    }
  }

  eks = {
    name = "my-eks-cluster"         # (Optional) EKS cluster name for auto-discovery of ARN, subnets, and security groups.
    # cluster_arn: "arn:aws:..."    # (Optional) EKS cluster ARN. Required if name is not provided.
    # cluster_name: "my-cluster"    # (Optional) Cluster name for tagging. Required if name is not provided.
    # subnet_ids: ["subnet-..."]    # (Optional) VPC subnet IDs. Required if name is not provided.
    # security_group_ids: ["sg-..."]  # (Optional) Security group IDs. Required if name is not provided.
  }

  grafana = {
    create                    = true              # (Required) Whether to create the Grafana workspace. Default: false.
    name_prefix               = "platform"        # (Optional) Prefix for auto-generated workspace name. Required if name not set.
    # name: "my-grafana"                          # (Optional) Full workspace name. Overrides name_prefix.
    account_access_type       = "CURRENT_ACCOUNT" # (Optional) Values: CURRENT_ACCOUNT, ORGANIZATION. Default: "CURRENT_ACCOUNT".
    authentication_providers  = ["AWS_SSO"]       # (Optional) Values: AWS_SSO, SAML.
    permission_type           = "SERVICE_MANAGED" # (Optional) Values: SERVICE_MANAGED, CUSTOMER_MANAGED. Default: "SERVICE_MANAGED".
    data_sources              = ["PROMETHEUS", "CLOUDWATCH", "XRAY"]  # (Optional) Values: PROMETHEUS, CLOUDWATCH, XRAY, TIMESTREAM, SITEWISE, ATHENA, REDSHIFT.
    notification_destinations = ["SNS"]           # (Optional) Values: SNS.
    grafana_version           = "10.4"            # (Optional) Grafana version. Uses AWS-managed default if omitted.
    description               = "Platform observability workspace"  # (Optional) Workspace description.
    # configuration: {}                           # (Optional) Grafana workspace configuration object (JSON-encoded).
    # organization_role_name: "..."               # (Optional) AWS Organizations role name for cross-account access.
    # organizational_units: ["ou-..."]            # (Optional) List of OU IDs to grant workspace access.
    aws_sso = [
      {
        role   = "ADMIN"                          # (Required) Grafana role. Values: ADMIN, EDITOR, VIEWER.
        groups = ["DevOps-Admins"]                # (Optional) List of AWS SSO group display names.
      },
      {
        role   = "EDITOR"
        groups = ["DevOps-Engineers"]
      },
      {
        role  = "VIEWER"
        users = ["readonly@example.com"]          # (Optional) List of AWS SSO usernames.
      }
    ]
  }

  vpc = {
    vpc_id                = "vpc-0abc123def456"              # (Optional) VPC ID. Required when create_security_group is true.
    subnet_ids            = ["subnet-0abc123", "subnet-0def456"]  # (Optional) Subnet IDs for Grafana VPC configuration.
    security_group_ids    = []                               # (Optional) Existing security group IDs to attach to Grafana.
    create_security_group = true                             # (Optional) Create a dedicated security group for Grafana. Default: false.
  }
}
```

## Quick Start

## Quick Start

**Prerequisites:**
- AWS account with permissions to create AMP workspaces, IAM roles, and CloudWatch log groups
- An existing EKS cluster
- Terragrunt installed

**Minimal setup (Prometheus scraping only):**

1. Create a `terragrunt.hcl` file:

```hcl
terraform {
  source = "github.com/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-aws-grafana-prometheus.git//?ref=v1.0.0"
}

include "root" {
  path = find_in_parent_folders()
}

inputs = {
  org = {
    organization_name = "MyCompany"
    organization_unit = "ops"
    environment_type  = "dev"
    environment_name  = "development"
  }

  prometheus = {
    default = {
      name_prefix = "myapp"
      scrapers = {
        eks = {
          name_prefix = "myapp"
        }
      }
    }
  }

  eks = {
    name = "my-eks-cluster"
  }
}
```

2. Initialize and apply:

```sh
terragrunt init
terragrunt apply
```

3. Retrieve the Prometheus endpoint from outputs:

```sh
terragrunt output prometheus
```

**To add Grafana**, set `grafana.create = true` and configure `authentication_providers` with at least one provider (e.g., `["AWS_SSO"]`).


## Examples

## Example: Prometheus-Only Deployment with EKS Scraping

Minimal configuration to deploy a single Prometheus workspace and scrape metrics from an existing EKS cluster:

```hcl
terraform {
  source = "github.com/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-aws-grafana-prometheus.git//?ref=v1.0.0"
}

include "root" {
  path = find_in_parent_folders()
}

inputs = {
  org = {
    organization_name = "Acme Corp"
    organization_unit = "platform"
    environment_type  = "prod"
    environment_name  = "production"
  }

  prometheus = {
    main = {
      name_prefix = "acme"
      logging = {
        create_log_group  = true
        retention_in_days = 14
      }
      scrapers = {
        primary = {
          name_prefix = "acme"
        }
      }
    }
  }

  eks = {
    name = "acme-prod-cluster"
  }
}
```

## Example: Full Stack with Grafana, SSO, KMS, and VPC

Production-grade deployment with encryption, network isolation, and SSO-based access:

```hcl
terraform {
  source = "github.com/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-aws-grafana-prometheus.git//?ref=v1.0.0"
}

include "root" {
  path = find_in_parent_folders()
}

inputs = {
  org = {
    organization_name = "Acme Corp"
    organization_unit = "platform"
    environment_type  = "prod"
    environment_name  = "production"
  }

  kms = {
    create              = true
    enable_key_rotation = true
  }

  prometheus = {
    main = {
      name_prefix = "acme"
      logging = {
        create_log_group  = true
        retention_in_days = 30
      }
      scrapers = {
        primary = {
          name_prefix = "acme"
        }
      }
    }
  }

  eks = {
    name = "acme-prod-cluster"
  }

  grafana = {
    create                   = true
    name_prefix              = "acme"
    account_access_type      = "CURRENT_ACCOUNT"
    authentication_providers = ["AWS_SSO"]
    permission_type          = "SERVICE_MANAGED"
    data_sources             = ["PROMETHEUS", "CLOUDWATCH", "XRAY"]
    notification_destinations = ["SNS"]
    aws_sso = [
      {
        role   = "ADMIN"
        groups = ["Platform-Admins"]
      },
      {
        role   = "EDITOR"
        groups = ["Platform-Engineers"]
      }
    ]
  }

  vpc = {
    vpc_id                = "vpc-0abc1234"
    subnet_ids            = ["subnet-0aaa", "subnet-0bbb"]
    create_security_group = true
  }
}
```
